blocking_findings.severity: BLOCKING — this is why the verdict is HOLD

finding_1.name: the T-family is not defined on the Massive X layer
finding_1.frozen_definition: t_sig=='T1' as materialized in bars (priority-resolved import of the Pine 'T' column; bullCode==5). Raw: prev1IsBear (close[1]<open[1] OR doji[1]) AND open>=close[1] AND open[1]>=open AND close>open[1] AND close>open. Canonical = raw with T4,T6,T1G,T2G resolved first. Machine-verified: overlap 219,0
finding_1.what_it_means: a T-state is an imported Pine column materialised into the legacy `bars` table and priority-resolved against T4/T6/T1G/T2G. It is not a formula over the Massive derived base, and the Massive V1 layer contains no t_sig.
finding_1.consequence: the study cannot be executed on the qualified X layer without a computable definition that does not currently exist

finding_2.name: the frozen definition records that the formula does not reproduce the column
finding_2.measured: overlap 219,016 / 220,351 = 99.39%; residual 1,335 rows (0.61%) of feed/tick class
finding_2.why_it_matters: recomputing T1 from Massive OHLC would produce a population that is nearly, but provably not, the frozen one. A study that swapped one for the other would report on a different object than its provenance ledger describes.
finding_2.priority_exclusions: T4 46,160 / T1G 2,008 / T6 632 / T2G 313 — the resolution order is part of the definition and its authority is the Pine source, not an artifact

finding_3.found: one occurrence of z_sig, in a stage artifact

blocking_findings.gate_rule_applied: If a parameter required to execute the current T/Z study is not explicitly frozen or explicitly decided in this pre-Y gate: HOLD. Do not insert a conventional/default value.

options.name: freeze the Pine T-column semantics as a computable spec, then implement on Massive
options.requires: the TZ_WLNBB Pine source as the authority, including the full priority-resolution order
options.effect: T-states become recomputable on the coarse layer with a stated, measured divergence from the legacy materialisation
options.note: the divergence must be MEASURED and recorded, not assumed to be the same 0.61%, because the source data differs

options.name: port T as a NEW pre-registered definition on Massive
options.effect: a distinct family with its own provenance class; the legacy T results are not evidence for it and vice versa
options.risk: two families with the same name and different populations is exactly the confusion this programme's naming discipline exists to prevent

options.name: scope the Massive V1 study to states definable from the frozen EMA/RVOL layer alone
options.effect: T/Z deferred entirely; the study proceeds on the X layer that is actually qualified
options.note: clean, but it is a different study from the one the charter names

hypothesis_provenance.binding: PREVIOUSLY EXPOSED · HYPOTHESIS-GENERATING · NOT PRISTINE DISCOVERY
hypothesis_provenance.rule: T1/T3/T9 were exposed to outcomes in the earlier 15m work. A larger, cleaner Massive dataset does not make those hypotheses new.
hypothesis_provenance.forbidden: describing a repeated appearance of a previously examined T-state as an independent hypothesis because the pipeline is new
hypothesis_provenance.no_survivor_search: the current family may not be built by testing only the components that survived the exposed 15m work

frozen_in_this_gate.note: everything specifiable WITHOUT inventing T/Z semantics is frozen here, so the eventual dictionary only has to add the piece that is genuinely missing

false_vs_unavailable.FALSE: all required X inputs are valid and the condition is not satisfied
false_vs_unavailable.UNAVAILABLE: one or more required inputs are unavailable, invalid or contaminated

feature_validity.ema: an EMA-dependent state is evaluable only where the exact required stream is VALID; INITIALIZATION_SENSITIVE and UNAVAILABLE do not satisfy it
feature_validity.rvol: INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE / ZERO_BASELINE / CURRENT_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE / PATH_CONTAMINATED all mean not evaluable, never below-threshold

clock_contract.rule: a coarse state completing at t cannot be treated as known before t
clock_contract.one_minute_role: a 1m clock may only timestamp the first causal minute at or after that availability boundary

rvol.threshold_source: must already be part of a frozen named hypothesis; may never be chosen from the X distribution or from Y

early_close.rvol: unavailable by construction under the frozen same-session-type / min-15 policy
early_close.consequence: any RVOL-conditioned hypothesis is unavailable on those 10 sessions

execution_timing.forbidden: executing at a price that helped construct the state
execution_timing.note: a historical state-transition association is not automatically a tradeability result

primary_vs_descriptive.statement: frequency alone is not predictive edge

not_frozen_and_why.item: computable T-state definition on the Massive X layer

not_frozen_and_why.note: the principles are recorded above; the concrete rules cannot be written against states that do not yet exist
the gate requires the count to be computable BEFORE Y; it is not computable before the states exist

not_frozen_and_why.item: Y horizon set and multiplicity family boundaries

required: an UNAVAILABLE condition cannot become FALSE
an INITIALIZATION_SENSITIVE EMA cannot satisfy a VALID-only condition
a contaminated coarse state cannot enter a COMPLETE-only state
a PATH_CONTAMINATED CUM-RVOL cannot satisfy a valid RVOL condition
an early-close unavailable RVOL cannot become below-threshold false
a future coarse bar cannot affect a current transition
a future outcome cannot influence state construction
same-bar execution cannot use a price already consumed by the state
an undeclared EMA period is rejected
an undeclared RVOL threshold is rejected
an undeclared state combination is rejected
an undeclared outcome horizon is rejected
an overlapping repeated state cannot silently multiply independent episodes
an excluded security cannot enter the analysis
supplemental / new-vintage data cannot enter V1
the report layer cannot create an unregistered inferential statistic

y_definition.reason: the gate permits defining Y mechanically, but a Y horizon is anchored to a transition timestamp and no transition dictionary can exist yet

guard.method: schema of every bound X dataset scanned for forward/outcome column tokens; the X layer physically cannot serve a Y value

decision_required: choose option A, B or C in blocking_findings.options. A needs the TZ_WLNBB Pine source as the authority for the T-column and its priority-resolution order.
